title: H1 Cubic P2240 Embedding
objective: Reconstruct the ordered PARI p2240 cubic number-field embedding from the neutral polynomial and integral basis, exactly across CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged native backends with transactional failure

handoff.summary: Implemented the no-oracle h1 all-real cubic embedding leaf. Neutral polynomial and integral-basis inputs now reproduce pristine PARI's three ordered p2176 roots and all nine make_M entries exactly, including the value-dependent p2240 entry, across CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged storage.
risks: The reviewed corridor is deliberately limited to separated all-real monic cubics at the authenticated p2176 root precision; it is not generic Uspensky isolation or a mixed-signature root implementation.
next_steps: Wire pari_cubic_embedding_rebuild into the h1 precision retry before pari_cubic_sunit_precision_rebuild and remove the injected high-precision embedding from that caller.
